subject: National FGLI Week Dinner Extravaganza - Friday
text:
Happy National FGLI Week!

Celebrate with us at the FGLI Week Dinner Extravaganza on Friday, November 6, 6-8pm, at the Afro-American Cultural Center. Dinner from Popeyes, Shah's Halal, and Basil.

All first-gen and low-income students and allies are welcome.
